title: AI Texture Generator & PBR Mapping Tools
author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
selftext:
Not sure how useful this even is in 2026 :D

PBR Mapping is instant, no AI used.

The Image Editor is a fun little tool.

The rest are AI Tools optimized for texture and HRDI Sphere Generation.

There is a bug report tool at the bottom left for any suggestions or feedback!

comments.author: imnotabot303
comments.body:
Here's some issues I found after just a few minutes of testing stuff:

It looks like a completely Gemini vibe coded site.

On the home page you have an image slider that looks like you should be able to click the images but nothing happens.

On the "social feed" page you have a bunch of textures with 1024 versions locked behind a subscription paywall. However you are using those images as the previews with a watermark that isn't even on the image. 

That means if I just download the page using the browser I get all those images without watermarks in 1024 format. I can also just inspect the HTML and download them directly too. So that's a bit pointless.

The HDRI created just isn't very good and they always have seams.

You give away free generations and I can sign up using a temp email so I can just continue creating new accounts for limitless generations.

replies.author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
replies.body:
I appreciate your feedback.

Vibe coded, yes. I didn't use Gemini and it's not 100%. Maybe 95 xD I feel like there are many great vibe coded apps though, implementation and getting them working is the harder part for people. 

I don't see any edge requests from my HDRI generator, and the previews are a PNG in webview. I'm assuming you just used the 3d viewer to inspect how the ones on the social feed would look? That feature is an ongoing work in progress (working on export options) as is everything. I am always testing and reiterating. There is post-processing done to the HDRI's post generation before it's displayed to the user. 

For the downloading of the page, I appreciate you alerting me of that possibility. Do you have any recommendations on how to fix that? Or what I should do there in general? 

In terms of free generations, that's just my choice. If people want to work around it they have the possibility to do so, but I also have ways on my end to mitigate that if I choose to be that involved or see abuse of edge functions. I've read enough of these threads to know people want to be able to try things out. There won't always be a free AI generation tier.. but gaining trust for me is a big factor right now. You will see sites out there a lot more expensive than us that maybe \*only\* do PBR Mapping at a rate limit. Our tiers are currently unlimited (and will remain so) unless people want to add-on a new feature I am going to implement soon that will bring the workflow itself to this website.. can't really say too much more on that.

replies.author: imnotabot303
replies.body:
The vibe coded thing is just about the overall look of the site. It has the style of something vibe coded. If you want people to start paying you a subscription then having a site that looks obviously vibe coded isn't going to instill confidence in people.

I generated 4 environment maps and when I viewed them in the 3D viewer they all had noticeable seams, some worse than others. I made these type of maps myself using loras and you can never get them perfect, especially at the poles. However I think it's not doing horizontal tiling correctly.

For the feed images, just use a size from the free tier like 512.

For the email thing just block temp email addresses, by making sure people can only sign up with a well known email like Hotmail, gmail etc. People can still abuse it but it's a lot more of a tedious process. That's up to you though as you're the one paying the costs.

replies.author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
replies.body:
Hey man,

I see you're pretty active and offer critiques quite frequently, even seen you being way harsher on other things than what I have here.

Any chance you can send me a message? I just want to pick your brain a bit in the game dev/design space. I also wanted your feedback on the textures you see. You only mentioned the HDRI Sphere. But overall, most of what I created here were things to help me in what I do - so knowledge from a person in the trenches would help me tremendously.

replies.author: imnotabot303
replies.body:
Yes I can be harsh I guess, I don't mean to but I'm a bit blunt sometimes, especially on things that are asking for people's money.

I didn't check out the whole site I just spent 5 minutes trying out a few things. There's some useful stuff on there though. I think one of the first things you should do is try and get away from the vibe coded look as it will definitely put people off. You could start by just doing something simple like changing up the colour scheme as the purple is a favourite of AI for some reason.

Anyway feel free to send me a message and I'll try and help if I can. I'm not an expert though. I used to work as a web designer but that was 15 years ago now.
